item.title: SoftmaxPIM: An HBM-Based PIM Architecture for Accelerating GeMV--Softmax Execution Pipeline
One paper accepted to IEEE CAL (Journal, SCIE)
item.description: One paper has been accepted for publication in IEEE Computer Architecture Letters. Our paper presents a processing-in-memory (PIM) architecture for accelerating GeMV-softmax compute pipeline, called SoftmaxPIM. In order to accelerate GeMV-softmax compute pipeline, SoftmaxPIM integrates lightweight near-bank softmax units based on an approximation-based softmax formulation alongside with the SIMD units on PIM dies of an HBM stack.

item.title: SparsePIM+: Accelerating SpMV on HBM-Based PIM via Logic-Die Accumulators with Opportunistic TSV Utilization
One paper accepted to Journal of Systems Architecture (Journal, SCIE)
item.description: One paper has been accepted to Journal of Systems Architecture. Our paper presents SparsePIM+, an HBM-based PIM architecture for accelerating SpMV kernels using logic-die accmulation. SpasrePIM+ is an extended research work from SparsePIM presented at ICS 2025. SparsePIM+ implements the accumulator logic on the logic die of an HBM stack to further merge the partial sums created on PIM dies. SparsePIM implements an efficient dataflow to the logic-die accumulators by issuing partial results opportunistically through underutilized TSVs.
